## 1. What Ramos will build from Jonathan's testimony, and what takes it away

| His line, built from Jonathan | The answer that does not need Jonathan | Lands |
|---|---|---|
| "He has no personal knowledge of 1975 to 2016; everything he says about the tenancy, the SPA and the sale is hearsay." | The defendants' own **Answer** admits the tenancy and rent (¶¶40, 43, 44[a][b]), and an admission in the same case "does not require proof" (Rule 129 §4). The SPA and the deed are **certified Registry copies**. **Patricia**, who signed the SPA, answers on rebuttal whatever they claim about it. | Now; rebuttal |
| "Even the plaintiff's witness says the SPA only let Cesar negotiate; the SPA plainly lets him sign. The plaintiff's theory is wrong." | Counsel states the theory as the class and the consultation, not "negotiate only." The certified SPA states paragraph 7 on its face; no witness is needed to read it. On cross, Erwin is asked to produce the Llamanzares contract he swears to; none exists (the cross-examination checklist (memorandum pack, Annex E)). | Defense stage |
| "No owner was ever left out; nobody can say there was no consultation." | Not proved first-hand in our case-in-chief; the class leg carries the demurrer. In the defense stage, Salvador's cross (S31: the owners never came home) and every claim of approval or ratification they make opens the door; Patricia answers on rebuttal. | Defense stage; rebuttal |
| "The family did nothing for years; he only learned in 2022" (laches, estoppel, ratification). | A void contract cannot be ratified (Art. 1409) and the action does not prescribe (Art. 1410). The **Agcaoili letter of 15 August 2019** and the **Bicol Post notice of 2020** (Exh. G) show the family acting before registration. Patricia explains her 2023 affidavit of loss on rebuttal, once they offer it as ratification. | Offer 9 Dec; rebuttal |
| "The Balanes bought in good faith; nothing was on the title." | Their own **Answer Annex "1"** (28 May 2020 SPA to defend the property); the **Elevado SPA of 15 September 2021** calling the land "my property" (Registry file Ref. 2025001098, p. 20); the **2020 publication** (Exh. G); **King's 9 July 2021 Verified Answer** in Civil Case 8563, through King and a certified Branch 41 copy. | 11 Nov; rebuttal |
| "The partition is regular; he cannot attack it collaterally." | Our own **Exhibit C**, the Balane title, states "DATE OF SUBD/CONS SURVEY: SEPTEMBER 8, 2020 · DATE APPROVED: APRIL 6, 2021." Exhibit B carries the partition entry dated 15 March 2017. The DENR file, Engr. Mangiga and the notarial registers complete it. | Now; rebuttal |
| "Builders in good faith; reimbursement and retention." | The Answer's own tenancy admission (Art. 1678, not Art. 448); on rebuttal, the Building Official's records and the Assessor's improvement declarations; De Leon on the 2020 events (Exh. N); dated imagery. | 4 Nov; rebuttal |
| "The whole case is a harassment campaign" (the counterclaim). | Nothing in our case-in-chief. The referrals are agency acts held for the defense stage. The counterclaim falls with the title. | Defense stage only |
